checks.name: source_actual_policy_cli
command:
import io,json,socket,sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from itov import evaluation,quality,training
from itov.catalog import sha256
from itov.catalog_store import CatalogStore
from itov.cli import main
from itov.config import load_config
config=load_config(Path('workspace/itov.toml'))
receipt=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/review-policy-reassessment-20260922.json').read_bytes())
prior=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-11b-training-attempt-03-20260922.json').read_bytes())
paths={p:sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes()) for p in prior['prior_file_sha256']}
old_receipts={p:sha256(p.read_bytes()) for p in Path('docs/evidence').glob('stage-11*.json')}
head=CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError('Unexpected network')
socket.socket.connect=forbidden
plan=Path(receipt['plan_path'])
review=Path(receipt['review_path'])
assert quality.packet(config,plan)==receipt['packet']
assert evaluation.candidate(config,plan)==receipt['candidate']
assert receipt['candidate']['entry']['asset']==prior['candidate']['entry']['asset']
for command,expected in [(['evaluation','packet',str(plan),'--save'],0),
 (['evaluation','assess',str(plan)],0),(['training','candidate',str(plan)],0),
 (['promotion','prepare',str(plan),'--review',str(review)],1)]:
    for as_json in (True,False):
        out=io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(out): result=main(command+(['--json'] if as_json else []))
        assert result==expected,(command,out.getvalue())
        if as_json and command[0]=='promotion':
            value=json.loads(out.getvalue())
            assert value==receipt['promotion']
            assert not any('human' in item.lower() for item in value['blockers'])
old=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-11-training-attempt-04-20260921.json').read_bytes())
assert training.status(config,Path(old['plan_path']))['status']=='succeeded'
assert evaluation.assess(config,Path(old['plan_path']))['technical_pass']
assert not evaluation.promotion(config,Path(old['plan_path']))['ok']
assert all(sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes())==h for p,h in paths.items())
assert all(sha256(p.read_bytes())==h for p,h in old_receipts.items())
assert CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head==head
assert not any(name in sys.modules for name in ('torch','diffusers','PIL','peft'))
print('Actual v3 assistant rejection and JSON/text commands validated offline; same model bytes, unchanged catalog,',len(paths),'prior workspace files and',len(old_receipts),'historical JSON receipts preserved; no ML imports')
checks.stdout: Actual v3 assistant rejection and JSON/text commands validated offline; same model bytes, unchanged catalog, 146 prior workspace files and 22 historical JSON receipts preserved; no ML imports
